environment.platform: Linux x64, 2 vCPU Intel Xeon 2.20 GHz

method: Median of three runs. Each run reports the median end-to-end preview time per fixture from a local HTTP server in the same Node.js process, after 5 warmups. Every timed result must extract the expected title.

notes.linkpeek: Measured from unreleased 3.0.0 source (merge commit bd1c9df); the install size is the published 2.1.7.
notes.link-preview-js: Measured as native fetch plus getPreviewFromContent(); its URL API rejects the private IP-literal benchmark host.
notes.open-graph-scraper: Measured as native fetch plus ogs({ html }); since 6.13.0 its URL API rejects non-public addresses with no opt-out.
notes.metascraper: Native fetch plus metascraper with 7 rule packages; metascraper does not fetch.

install.note: Clean npm install --ignore-scripts of the pinned published version; metascraper includes the same 7 rule packages.
